title: Pointwise stalk injections into integral constant pushforwards
statement: On a Noetherian scheme X, for a finite commutative ring Lambda, a constructible module sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and x in X, there are integral nu : Y -> X, finite Lambda-module M and phi : F -> nu_* M_Y such that the geometric stalk map of phi is injective at every geometric point with underlying point x [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

source.place: Tag 09Z6 proof of (1), generic trivialization, normalization and stalk square, transferred to (3)

proof.text: Obtain Y, nu, K, g, finite M, invertible generic unit u, generic isomorphism alpha and geometric-point lifts from normalized generic data. Write A=nu^*F and B=M_Y. Define psi:A -> B as the g-adjoint of alpha followed by u inverse. Functoriality, the left triangle identity, and the inverse hom-equivalence identity give g^*psi=alpha. Define phi:F -> nu_*B as the nu-adjoint of psi; its inverse hom-equivalence identity gives nu^*phi followed by the counit equal to psi.

For any geometric s above x choose w with w followed by g and nu equal to s. Naturality of upperStarCompSheafFiberIso for g conjugates the stalk of psi at w followed by g to the stalk of g^*psi=alpha. Hence the stalk of psi is an isomorphism.

Naturality of upperStarCompSheafFiberIso for nu, applied to phi, and the counit identity above factor an isomorphism (the inverse comparison followed by the stalk of psi) through the stalk of phi. By mono_of_mono_fac the stalk of phi is monic. ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective gives the required injectivity for every s. This uses only naturality of the stalk comparison, not a germ description of the counit.

theorem exists_integral_lowerStar_stalk_injective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) (x : X) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ν : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom ν ∧
      ∃ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Finite M ∧
        ∃ (φ : F ⟶ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)),
          ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
            ((Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω X) s).1 = x →
              Function.Injective
                (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map φ)
